# Noisy-OR module diagnosis (generated by experiments/diagnose_noisy_or_modules.py)

Links start at logit -3 and Adam moves a parameter by about one learning rate per step, so largest_link_travel_possible bounds how far any link could have moved by the best epoch. evaluation_gate_at_median is the gate the evaluation used at the median log-alpha; expected_training_gate_at_median is the mean gate the training passes saw there.
